lede: Wat Phra That Chang Kham Worawihan accounts for 109 catalogued manuscripts, 26 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (98% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (96%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (66%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (31%). Dated witnesses run 1501–1978 CE (53 of 109 carry a date).
